title: 完整人工智能培训课程仓库
summary: 该仓库包含Prof. Fernando Amaral的完整人工智能培训课程，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、LLM、生成式AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法、模糊逻辑等，提供理论与实践结合的Python项目与笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for the Complete Artificial Intelligence Training by Prof. Fernando Amaral, covering ML, DL, LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, Agents, Computer Vision, Anomaly Detection, Genetic Algorithms, Fuzzy Logic, with hands-on Python projects and notebooks.
